headline: Nasdaq (NDAQ) Ends Its Patent Fight With Miami And Clears A Long Legal Overhang
summary: NasdaqGS:NDAQ and Miami International Holdings resolved a multi year patent dispute that began in 2017. A court dismissed all related claims and confirmed that Miami International Holdings can operate and develop exchanges without restriction. The outcome addresses questions around technology rights and market access between the two exchange groups. Nasdaq sits at the center of global capital markets as a major exchange operator and technology provider for trading, market data and related...
